content: November 14, 2024 NCEZID Organizational Chart At a glance CDC's National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID) works to protect people at home and abroad from emerging and zoonotic infections. NCEZID has eight divisions that cover different aspects of infectious diseases.
